title:
Response type for K8sApiServer methods "podMetrics" and "podMetricsForNameSpace".
Field 'items' is list of 'K8sPodMetrics' containing the CPU/Memory usage data for all pods within given
namespace (with method 'podMetricsForNameSpace'), or all pods on Kubernetes (with method 'podMetrics').
This is to get response type "PodMetricsList" in
https://github.com/kubernetes/metrics/blob/master/pkg/apis/metrics/v1beta1/types.go
name: K8sApiServerPodMetricsResult
